where: my own method: a temporary counter of who asks each memo
what: To find who verifies each memo I patched blaze-query's counter to keep one stack in three (never committed). The first build of it sampled from the daemon's start, so the cold build took a stack for every third of millions of memos and did not end; and my filter for ix's progress lines (`grep -v '^  '`) hid the first table, whose lines began with two spaces.
cost: two extra builds of the engine (12 minutes) and one empty report
cause: the profile has no table of who asked a memo from outside a query; `query_counts` says how many
workaround: the counter starts when a file appears; report lines begin with a letter
state: open: a `verified_by` sample (the asker's innermost non-engine frame, one in N) in the profile would have answered this with no build
